profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Deutsche Bank | UNC- Chapel Hill Alumni
profile.summary: I'm a Computer Science graduate from UNC-Chapel Hill. My academic journey covered a broad spectrum of topics, from algorithms to software development. What sets me apart is my dedication to continuous learning, demonstrated through internships and collaborative projects. With a solid foundation and practical experience, I'm excited to contribute to the tech industry.

positions.locationName: Raleigh, North Carolina, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Collaborated within the US REG Regulatory Reporting Team to spearhead the development and automation of a QoQ template for the FR-9C form.
Employed Python libraries, such as Openpyxl and Pandas, in conjunction with Jupyter Notebook to execute meticulous testing and data manipulation.
Presented the project's outcomes to high-level executives from Credit Suisse and UBS, showcasing technical prowess and effective communication skills in a NYC audience setting.

projects.title: Admin Dashboard
projects.description:
Front End Admin Dashboard that used technologies that uses React, JavaScript, Tailwind, and Syncfusion. 
An admin dashboard app using React.js and Syncfusion. This has been one if not the most significant projects I have ever taken on. You could say there are multiple projects inside of this one since the Admin Dashboard App has Theming, Tables, Charts, Calendar, Kanban, and More. 
Visit: https://williamadmindash.netlify.app/ for a demonstration.
Source code: https://github.com/William-Garcia/AdminDashboard

projects.title: Personal Portfolio
projects.description: Seems like we are getting ourselves in a loop or a recursion. A portfolio is your resume and your business card so I decided I need one too. All of my experiences will go here and be documented alongside the source code and a link to visit to check them out.
